findings.title: DefaultMadChance raised from 0.4 to 0.95 silently changes every existing install
findings.detail: madChance is saved with Scribe_Values.Look(ref madChance, "madChance", DefaultMadChance) (DungeonSettings.cs:129), so a player who left the slider at the old 40% default has nothing saved and will be read as 95% after this update. IsDweller excludes mad pawns (DungeonDwellers.cs:24-26), so sane dwellers, and with them the invite/join flow this build works on, become rare. This looks like a test value left in. Revert DungeonSettings.cs:51 to 0.4f, or if the change is meant, mention it in the changelog.

findings.title: One-stack-per-shelf can still be exceeded by an oversize stack
findings.detail: The `GetItemCount(map) > 0` check only blocks a tile that is already used. If a generated stack is larger than its stackLimit, GenPlace.TryPlaceDirect splits it into up to GetMaxItemsAllowedInCell stacks on that same empty tile. This is rare with MapGen_DefaultStockpile and breaks nothing; worth knowing if the one-per-shelf rule is meant to be strict.

findings.title: A carried follower with no caravan outside when the map closes stays in the stash
findings.detail: Notify_MyMapAboutToBeRemoved only makes a caravan from a stashed player-faction colonist. A downed follower is factionless until the roll, so if no caravan is waiting, FlushStash(null) returns early and the roll never happens; the follower is lost with the site. This was already the case before this build, and the new code doesn't make it worse.
